findings.evidence: Lines 18-28 contain direct cross-domain imports: `from domains.accounts.services.auth.auth_service import (change_password, disable_totp, enable_totp, get_totp_status, setup_totp)` and `from domains.accounts.services.sessions.session_service import (list_sessions, revoke_session)`. These reach into the services tree directly, bypassing ports.py.
findings.benchmark_mismatch: Law 3 (cross-domain reads only via ports.py) and L-17: 'events.py (writes) and ports.py (reads) are the ONLY sanctioned cross-domain channels'. The supplier module (AXIS 1) must import from domains.accounts.ports, not domains.accounts.services.
findings.notes: domains/accounts/ports.py exports `list_active_user_sessions` (different from `list_sessions`) and `get_referral_dashboard` via lazy import pattern (lines 122-129, 149-152). The six functions imported by this router (change_password, disable_totp, enable_totp, get_totp_status, setup_totp, list_sessions, revoke_session) are NOT in ports.py. The ports.py lazy export dict _LAZY_SERVICE_EXPORTS (line 217) does not include any of these. Fix requires adding lazy exports to ports.py and changing the router to import from ports.
